result.description:
Lead reliability at one of Australia's largest food manufacturing facilities!

At JBS Dinmore, the largest and most respected beef processing plants in the southern hemisphere, we are seeking an experienced Maintenance Superintendent to join our Maintenance Leadership Team.

Reporting to the Engineering Manager, you will be responsible for overseeing all maintenance activities within the abattoir, ensuring equipment reliability, compliance with WHS standards, and minimal downtime. This role manages maintenance teams, coordinates preventive and corrective maintenance, and supports continuous improvement initiatives to optimise plant performance This is a full-time role with annual salary higher than $120,000 plus Superannuation.

Key Responsibilities

· Plan, schedule, and supervise preventive and corrective maintenance activities.

· Ensure compliance with WHS, environmental, and food safety standards during maintenance operations.

· Manage maintenance team performance, rosters, and resource allocation.

· Monitor equipment reliability and implement strategies to reduce downtime.

· Coordinate with Production, QA, and Engineering to resolve technical issues promptly.

· Maintain accurate records of maintenance activities, spare parts usage, and equipment history.

· Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance maintenance efficiency and cost-effectiveness.

· Ensure compliance with statutory inspections and regulatory requirements.

· Support capital projects and installation of new equipment.

· Encourage open communication so staff feel comfortable reporting hazards, equipment issues, or training needs.

· Reinforce teamwork between maintenance, operations, and QA, helping everyone understand the impact of their role on plant performance and food safety.

· Serve as a trusted point of contact for technical questions, offering approachable and supportive guidance.

· Additional tasks as requested by your supervisor or management.

About You

· Extensive experience in industrial maintenance within food processing or manufacturing.

· Strong knowledge of mechanical, electrical, and refrigeration systems.

· Understanding of WHS, environmental, and food safety compliance.

· Leadership and team management skills.

· Ability to analyse data and implement reliability improvement strategies.

· Trade qualification or engineering degree.

· Experience with CMMS (Computerised Maintenance Management Systems).

· Knowledge of Lean or continuous improvement methodologies.

Why Join JBS?

Leadership opportunity within Australia's largest food manufacturer
Influence reliability and maintenance strategy across a major production facility
Work with large-scale industrial equipment and modern automation systems
Ongoing professional development and career progression opportunities
Supportive leadership team and stable, long-term employment
If you're an experienced electrical leader ready to make a significant impact in a complex manufacturing environment, we'd love to hear from you.

The Ad is valid for 28 days.

Apply now and help drive operational excellence at JBS Dinmore.

Workshop boilermaker role focused on fabrication, crane builds and precision assembly with a 9-day fortnight    Your new company  Our client is a well-established engineering and fabrication business with a strong reputation for delivering high-quality steel products and crane solutions. Operating a modern workshop environment, they pride themselves on precision workmanship, safety, and delivering complex projects to exacting standards.   Your new role  In this position, you will be based in the workshop, completing high-quality fabrication, welding, and assembly work. You will be involved in the build of crane beams and hoists, including full fabrication, mechanical fit-out, and testing. The role requires working from engineering drawings to tight tolerances, ensuring accuracy and compliance with specifications. You will also undertake a variety of tasks including machining, cutting, bending, rolling, grinding, drilling, and assembling steel components.   What you'll need to succeed  
 
 Trade qualified Boilermaker 
 Strong fabrication experience in a workshop environment 
 Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings independently 
 Experience working to tight tolerances and specifications 
 Competency across fabrication processes including cutting, bending, rolling and assembly 
 High attention to detail and commitment to quality workmanship 
 Ability to complete a pre-employment medical & Police Check 
 Ability to work both autonomously and within a team 
 
  What you'll get in return  You will secure a role with a respected and stable company offering consistent workshop-based work and a strong focus on fabrication. The position provides a competitive casual rate of $58.06 plus overtime penalties, along with the benefit of a 9-day fortnight supporting work-life balance. This is an excellent opportunity to further develop your fabrication skills on specialised projects in a well-equipped workshop environment.   What you need to do now  If you're interested in this role, applications can be submitted via the "apply now" button. Please ensure you are submitting an up-to-date CV. result.description: RMEM ENGINEERING PTY LTD  RMEM Engineering Pty Ltd is seeking a   Systems and Resource Analyst to support the optimisation of business systems, resource allocation, and operational performance across the organisation.  This role will act as a key link between technical systems and business operations, ensuring efficient utilisation of resources and continuous improvement of workflows.   Benefits   Competitive salary  Health and wellness programs  Professional development opportunities  Paid time off    Task & responsibilities   Identify, investigate and analyse complex business processes, operational procedures, and resource planning practices across RMEM’s mechanical, electrical and fabrication operations.  Work closely with business users and stakeholders to gather, analyse and document functional business requirements for system improvements, resource management and system integrations.  Use data and process modelling techniques to develop clear and detailed system specifications to support the design, development and enhancement of business systems and ERP platforms.  Act as a central technical reference and information resource, providing expert advice and guidance to management on system functionality, performance and project decision-making.  Identify system inefficiencies and operational bottlenecks, and recommend and implement improvements to optimise workflows, system performance and resource allocation.  Apply project management methodologies and techniques to plan, coordinate and deliver system improvement initiatives, including resource planning, scheduling and cost considerations.  Configure, maintain and enhance ERP systems to support accurate reporting, predictive modelling and efficient capacity planning across operations.  Collaborate with developers, IT teams and system providers to design, test and implement system improvements and integrations aligned with business requirements.  Develop and execute system testing plans to ensure the quality, functionality and integrity of system solutions prior to deployment.  Prepare user documentation and deliver training to staff to support effective adoption and utilisation of systems and process improvements.    Qualification & experience   Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field  Minimum 1 years of experience in systems analysis or related field   Strong knowledge of system design and implementation  Excellent problem-solving skills  Ability to work independently and in a team environment   About Company    RMEM Engineering Pty Ltd is a leading Western Australian engineering company specialising in high-quality mechanical, electrical and fabrication services for the mining, resources and industrial sectors. With over 20 years of experience, RMEM operates from a state-of-the-art facility in Canning Vale, delivering innovative, reliable and efficient solutions to some of Australia’s largest and most complex operations. Known for its technical expertise, advanced capabilities and commitment to excellence, RMEM continues to drive operational performance and long-term value for its clients. Ahrens Mining & Industrial Services was established over 30 years ago. During this time, the company has gained an outstanding reputation for supplying welding and fabrication services to the petro-chemical and mining industry within the state of Western Australia.

The company employs over 100 highly skilled employees as boilermakers, pipe fitters and welders, with over 35 years of experience in the construction industry. - Maintaining, diagnosing faults and repairing mechanical machinery and equipment

Pressure Welder

•	Permanent Role 
•	$85k-$90k PA 
•	Pinkenba QLD

POSITION

Full-time position for a Pressure Welder is available in Pinkenba, QLD, 4008.

SKILLS

At least an AQF Certificate III, including at least two years of on-the-job training or a Certificate Ivin a relevant field. At least three years of relevant experience may substitute for the formal qualification. In addition to the qualification at least one year of relevant work experience is required.

RESPONSIBILITIES

The Pressure Welder is responsible for assembling, welding, inspecting, testing and repairing pressure vessels, pipes, pipelines, boilers, tanks and associated pressure-containing components in accordance with engineering drawings, approved welding procedures, relevant Australian Standards and industry specifications.
The role requires precision welding using MMAW, GTAW (TIG), GMAW (MIG) and FCAW processes on carbon steel, stainless steel and alloy materials in workshop and site environments.

POSITION DUTIES

•	Read and interpret engineering drawings, blueprints, welding procedure specifications and technical specifications to determine job requirements and appropriate welding techniques for pressure systems.
•	Select, measure, cut, shape, bend, bevel, clean and prepare metal sections and pipes using hand tools, heating equipment and metalworking machinery.
•	Align, fit and secure pipes, vessel components and other pressure-containing components before welding.
•	Assemble, weld and repair pressure vessels, pipes, pipelines, boilers and tanks to relevant standards and approved welding procedures.
•	Operate welding equipment using MMAW, GTAW (TIG), GMAW (MIG) and FCAW
processes.
•	Weld in various positions, including vertical and overhead positions, and in confined spaces where required.
•	Conduct pre-heating, post-weld heat treatment, stress-relief and finishing processes as specified.
•	Examine welds for bead width, penetration, precision, defects and compliance with applicable standards and specifications.
•	Conduct or assist with pressure, leak and other weld-integrity testing to confirm that pressure-containing systems meet required standards.
•	Repair defective welds and complete rework in accordance with approved procedures.
•	Clean and smooth welds by grinding, filing, chiselling and polishing as required.
•	Perform routine inspection and maintenance of welding equipment and report equipment defects. 
•	Comply with workplace health and safety requirements, permit systems and safe work procedures.
•	Work collaboratively with fabricators, boilermakers, inspectors and engineers to complete work to specification.

ADDITIONAL ATTRIBUTES

•	Willingness to learn and develop new skills
•	Strong communication skills
•	High level of attention to detail
•	Commitment to workplace health and safety
•	Effective problem-solving skills
•	Ability to work both independently and as part of a team

SALARY

$85,000 - $90,000 per annum based on experience.

TO APPLY
Applications in Word format should be submitted via our website: 
https://precruitment.com.au/job-seekers/

Key Responsibilities
Plan, organise, and oversee end-to-end delivery of ICT projects, ensuring milestones, objectives, and deliverables are met within agreed timeframes and budgets
Analyse organisational information needs and specify appropriate technology solutions to address those requirements effectively

Proficiency in project management methodologies such as PMBOK, PRINCE2, or Agile/Scrum frameworks

Proven ability to manage budgets, resource plans, and project schedules using tools such as MS Project, Jira, or equivalent platforms

Sound analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a structured approach to risk and issue management

PMP (Project Management Professional) or PRINCE2 Practitioner certification
ITIL Foundation certification or experience working within ITIL-aligned service environments
Experience delivering projects within Agile or hybrid delivery models
Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud
Experience in change management practices and supporting organisational technology transitions
Exposure to enterprise resource planning (ERP) or large-scale system implementation projects
Prior experience working within highly regulated industries such as finance, healthcare, or government

The role is responsible for assessing customer sites, identifying technical requirements, validating project feasibility and providing accurate information to support engineering, sales and project delivery teams   Key Responsibilities    Conduct site inspections for commercial and industrial solar and battery projects.  Complete detailed site assessment reports including photographs, measurements and technical observations.  Assess existing electrical infrastructure, switchboards, transformers and distribution networks.  Identify installation constraints, safety risks and compliance requirements.  Verify customer energy infrastructure and meter configurations.  Review roof conditions, structural considerations and cable pathways.  Confirm available switchboard capacity and connection requirements.  Identify opportunities for battery energy storage systems (BESS), EV charging and energy efficiency upgrades.  Liaise directly with customers, facility managers, site managers and contractors during inspections.  Support engineering teams with the technical information required for system design.  Assist with commissioning, troubleshooting and defect resolution when required. The role ensures all electrical work is completed safely, efficiently and in accordance with Australian Standards, statutory requirements and company procedures.            Benefits  Work vehicle   Task & responsibilities   KEY RESPONSIBILITIES   The Electrician will be responsible for, but not limited to:   Installing, testing, commissioning, maintaining and repairing electrical wiring, equipment, switchboards, lighting systems and electrical installations.  Reading and interpreting electrical drawings, wiring diagrams, specifications and technical documentation to determine installation requirements.  Measuring, marking out and installing electrical wiring, conduits, cables and associated equipment.  Connecting electrical systems, switchboards, distribution boards and equipment to power supplies.  Testing electrical installations using specialised testing equipment to verify safety, functionality and compliance with Australian Standards.  Diagnosing electrical faults and carrying out repairs or replacing defective wiring, equipment and components.  Installing and commissioning communications cabling, data cabling, security systems, smoke alarms and associated electrical equipment.  Installing electrical components associated with air conditioning systems in accordance with applicable licensing requirements.  Performing preventative and reactive maintenance on domestic, commercial and industrial electrical systems.  Conducting switchboard upgrades, lighting upgrades, power installations and electrical fit-outs for new and existing buildings.  Ensuring all work complies with the Electrical Safety Act, relevant Australian Standards, workplace health and safety requirements and company procedures.  Liaising with clients, builders, project managers and other trades to coordinate works and ensure projects are completed on time.  Completing job documentation, testing records, compliance certificates and service reports accurately.  Maintaining tools, equipment and company vehicles in a safe and serviceable condition.    Qualification & experience   SKILLS, QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE    Essential    Certificate III in Electrotechnology Electrician (or equivalent recognised qualification).  Current Queensland Electrical Work Licence.  Minimum three (3) years' relevant post-qualification experience as an Electrician.  Demonstrated experience undertaking domestic, commercial and industrial electrical installations and maintenance.  Ability to read and interpret electrical plans, wiring diagrams and technical specifications.  Sound knowledge of the AS/NZS 3000 Wiring Rules and relevant Australian Standards.  Experience using electrical testing and diagnostic equipment.  Strong fault-finding and problem-solving skills.  Excellent communication and customer service skills.  Current unrestricted Australian Driver Licence.  Ability to work independently and as part of a team.    Desirable    Restricted or unrestricted Air Conditioning Licence.  Open Cabling Registration.  Experience installing data and communications cabling.  Experience installing CCTV, security and access control systems.  Elevated Work Platform (EWP), Working at Heights, CPR/LVR and White Card certifications.      About Company    Trecs Electrical Pty Ltd is a Queensland-based electrical contracting company providing high-quality domestic, commercial and industrial electrical services throughout Brisbane, Rockhampton and surrounding regions. The company specialises in electrical installations, maintenance, communications and data cabling, air conditioning installations, security systems, switchboard upgrades, lighting solutions and electrical services for new construction and refurbishment projects.
